title: Robert Goddard rocket testing at Roswell
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Robert Goddard rocket testing at Roswell, about 1940s at Roswell, New Mexico, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I mean, Robert Goddard, who is a rocket pioneer in the US, had just been testing V2 rockets at it right at Roswell.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Robert Goddard, an American rocket pioneer, had been testing V2 rockets, a type of early long-range rocket, right at Roswell, New Mexico, in the 1940s. Michels raises it because Roswell is the town where a strange object is said to have crashed in 1947, and the rocket work would make it a place of unusual military interest.
